prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of an airless cosmetic pump JAR. CRITICAL CONTAINER DETAILS — the body is OPAQUE MATTE WHITE plastic (pure white, NOT amber, NOT brown, NOT glass, NOT translucent), a smooth cylindrical white jar; the cap is a tall SMOOTH WHITE DOMED twist cap that sits flush over the body (NOT a lotion pump, NOT a spout, NOT a nozzle, NOT a dispenser head). The WHOLE container is white — there is NO amber or brown anywhere. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY for this white jar shape, the white domed cap, the white body, label placement, AVID-RA branding, materials and lighting. BACKGROUND seamless very-light warm grey, soft key light from top-left, jar vertically centered ~90% of frame height, soft contact shadow. On the white lower body, CENTERED navy text, top to bottom: the AVID-RA molecule logo (blue node/molecule icon) with 'AVID-RA' and the small 'COMPLEX AMINO RESEARCH' tagline; then the product name 'GHK-Cu PLUS' in navy #1b2846 (largest, ONE line); then a single row with 'Gel cream' at the LEFT and '30ml' at the RIGHT in muted grey #5b687b. This product is AVID-RA brand, NOT Regenic|Lab. There is NO schedule badge, NO dose/strength number, NO 'Jar' text, and ABSOLUTELY NO 'RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY' line anywhere. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: replicate the reference's text sizes, centering and spacing exactly; do not enlarge or invent text. No 'Novecy' or other third-party branding. Clean premium research-grade skincare product image, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 406x595.
